subject: Final-mile MAP relock and acceleration ask
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Johnson <emma@dovetailhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@dovetailhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Final-mile MAP relock and acceleration ask

Hi Emma / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, Dovetail's evaluation window is the gating item for final acceptance and the current MAP (attached) has slipped relative to the internal go/no-go. To keep the Q3 cadence intact we need to lock a short remediation plan this week.

Quick summary of asks:
- Can procurement confirm whether the PO/contract signature can land by 2026-08-31 (their current target)?
- If PO can slide to mid-September we need to rebaseline the MAP and acceptance dates (proposed below).
- If PO stays on 8/31 but evaluation cannot compress, Redwood can offer a dedicated 2-week canary pool + prioritized onboarding to shorten validation time.

Attached: Dovetail_MAP_v3.xlsx (proposed relock), Risk_Log_20260814.csv (initial risk register).

Proposed rebaseline (if acceptance shifts):
- Can we move final acceptance to 2026-09-17?
- Staged go-live (limited traffic) 2026-09-10 

Ben and Rishi are looped for technical/ops commitments. I can jump on a quick slot today to finalize wording for the MAP update and credit language (if needed).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: Dovetail_MAP_v3.xlsx, Risk_Log_20260814.csv
From: Emma Johnson <emma@dovetailhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@dovetailhealth.com>, Mark Patel <mark.patel@dovetailhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile MAP relock and acceleration ask

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear options. Quick answers from our side: procurement is prioritizing the PO but we cannot guarantee an 8/31 signature given internal budget committee meets 8/28 and may push to 9/03. Security/compliance has flagged the SOC2 evidence as an outstanding item which may add a week to their checklist.

If Redwood can provide a short, supported canary (as you suggested) that would materially reduce our ops team's risk and make the earlier acceptance more realistic.

Can you confirm what "prioritized onboarding" entails (engineer time, runbook handoff, success metrics) and the maximum committed capacity of the canary pool? Also: any temporary language you can include in the MAP that limits exposure while we complete procurement would help get the internal stakeholders comfortable.

Emma
Director of Clinical Integrations
Dovetail Health
emma@dovetailhealth.com

Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -0700

On Fri, Aug 14, 2026 at 11:15 AM Emma Johnson <emma@dovetailhealth.com> wrote:
> Can you confirm what "prioritized onboarding" entails...?

Emma / Marissa —

We can commit the following for a two-week canary to materially shorten evaluation time:
- Dedicated 1x Senior Solutions Engineer (SE) for onboarding and runbook creation (up to 40h across the canary window).
- Priority queueing on our Dedicated pool for the eval traffic: up to 4 vGPU instances reserved for the two-week period.
- Weekly checkpoints with Dovetail's ops (30m) + shared acceptance checklist.
- Success metrics: 95th p99 token latency within agreed SLO, and stability for a 72-hour continuous window.

I'll attach a short delta to the Risk_Log with mitigations and the operational commitment. If procurement needs a stand-in SLA/cutover plan in the MAP, we can draft provisional language that limits liability until the PO is signed.

Ben
Head of Customer Solutions
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Risk_Log_20260817_update.csv
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Johnson <emma@dovetailhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@dovetailhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final-mile MAP relock and acceleration ask

Emma / Procurement —

Thanks for the transparency. On the compliance ask: we can provide the SOC2 summary and an engineer-facing evidence packet today (attached). The full SOC2 report requires an NDAs/controls-access form but for procurement review the summary + control matrix should suffice to unblock the committee.

Practical next steps from compliance side:
- We'll share SOC2_Summary_Redwood_2026Q2.pdf and a short control matrix (attached).
- If the budget committee needs a formal evidence handover, we'll coordinate a short readout (30m) with our security team.

If procurement can accept the summary along with the provisional MAP addendum (Ben/Marissa: please draft), we can keep the earlier acceptance path viable while the PO works through signatures.

Mina Haddad
Director, Security & Compliance
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SOC2_Summary_Redwood_2026Q2.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Dovetail PO timing risk (DW-4283) — approval requested for provisional concessions

Laura —

TL;DR: Dovetail (DW-4283) may push the PO past 8/31 because of a budget committee sync and a SOC2 evidence verification step. We have a concrete mitigation (two-week canary + prioritized capacity) that materially reduces acceptance time, but procurement wants provisional language & assurances before they greenlight internal sign-off.

Why I am escalating: this deal is a strong Q3 close candidate but the current MAP slip would push parts of expected revenue into Q4. The customer has evaluation risk (security evidence) that Mina can satisfy with summary docs, and Ben can provide the operational commitments. What we need from leadership: permission to offer a one-time Q3 acceleration credit up to $25k (to offset their internal timing friction) and a short-term provisional SLA addendum that limits exposure until the PO is signed.

Ask: please confirm by EOD Thu 2026-08-19 if we can extend the provisional concessions above. If approved I will: 1) finalize the MAP addendum, 2) prepare the credit paperwork with finance, and 3) coordinate a readout for Dovetail's budget committee.

Notes:
- Attachments (again) include proposed MAP relock and the updated risk log.
- Deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4283

Thanks —
Marissa
